explanation: Searched Mathlib for any distinct declaration stating that `IsPreconnected J` follows from `IsPreconnected Jᵒᵖ` (grep for `isPreconnected_of_isPreconnected_op`, `isPreconnected_op_iff`, `IsPreconnected Jᵒᵖ ↔`, and general `op` lemmas about `IsPreconnected`/`IsConnected`). The only related declarations in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/IsConnected.lean` are `isPreconnected_of_equivalent` (general equivalence transfer), the instance `isPreconnected_op` (the converse direction, `IsPreconnected J → IsPreconnected Jᵒᵖ`), and `isConnected_of_isConnected_op` / `isConnected_op_iff_isConnected` for the nonempty/connected case. There is no lemma `isPreconnected_op_iff_isPreconnected` or any single declaration whose statement is this backward transfer: deriving it needs both `isPreconnected_of_equivalent (opOpEquivalence J)` and the instance `isPreconnected_op` (to supply `[IsPreconnected Jᵒᵖᵒᵖ]`), i.e. it is genuinely the library's own theorem rather than an instantiation or duplicate of a Mathlib declaration.
